task: Retain ABI-v10 checked body semantic hashes from compiler facts.
observation: A checked generic body such as return value + 1 and the same body with + 2 projected identical open-summary TypeRefs, effects and requirements. The Function and Stmt AST retained expression strings but no resolved literal/operator nodes, so a hash over existing typed summary fields would falsely identify distinct behavior as equal.
impact: The typed semantic API cannot provide expected semantic dependency hashes for all exportable generic bodies. A narrow checked Return expression IR now publishes a canonical SHA-256 only for resolved parameter/integer/addition nodes and reports an explicit unavailable status for all other body forms.

resolution.summary: The narrow checked IR proves literal changes affect hashes without source path or whitespace sensitivity. Full ordered statement/control-flow and call-target IR plus dependency hashes remain open A4 work.
